notice: Planned acceptance scenarios. This catalog is not evidence that application tests exist or passed.

tests.givenWhen: Launch on recorded Arch/Hyprland with and without a tray/keyring/portal.
tests.then: A usable window remains reachable; each missing capability is explicit; quitting stops scheduling.

tests.givenWhen: Scaffold from a pinned inspected tauri-ui version and inspect release assets/capabilities.
tests.then: No demo dashboard, sample success invoke, remote script, debug panel or telemetry enters release.

tests.givenWhen: Use owned/private/fork/archived/collaboration fixtures under partial token grants.
tests.then: Only the selected authorized scope is included; invisible resources are not counted as discovered.

tests.givenWhen: A GitHub catalog spans three pages; page two rate-limits or returns 403.
tests.then: Previous items remain; completeness is false; no local or remote deletion is scheduled.

tests.givenWhen: Rename/transfer a repository and introduce case-insensitive name collisions.
tests.then: Stable source ID/mapping/history is preserved; unrelated local/destination repos are not overwritten.

tests.givenWhen: Choose valid, unwritable, traversal, symlink-escape and pre-existing foreign root paths.
tests.then: Only validated app-owned paths can be mutated; picker cancellation performs no write.

tests.givenWhen: Run complete scan/plan/sync lifecycle using a source remote that rejects all pushes.
tests.then: No source write is attempted; network trace contains only permitted reads to GitHub.

tests.givenWhen: Change a non-default branch and move an annotated tag while metadata hints remain unchanged.
tests.then: All selected logical ref/OID changes are detected; peeled tags and symbolic HEAD are not extra refs.

tests.givenWhen: Deliver partial observations and a newer event followed by an older snapshot.
tests.then: Unknown/stale remains distinct; older revisions cannot regress current state or fake verification.

tests.givenWhen: Queue 100 repositories with concurrency 3, duplicate requests and queue pause.
tests.then: At most 3 run; no duplicate repo mutation; pause prevents new starts but does not fake paused processes.

tests.givenWhen: Kill the app before/after project creation, push and persistence checkpoints.
tests.then: Restart reconciles observed destination before retry; no duplicate project or false success.

tests.givenWhen: Validate empty, invalid, expired and insufficient-scope PATs using controlled adapters.
tests.then: Typed actionable errors; identity alone does not claim create/push permission.

tests.givenWhen: Store, reconnect and disconnect with keyring available, locked and unavailable.
tests.then: No plaintext fallback; explicit session-only mode; disconnect preserves backups.

tests.givenWhen: Submit malformed envelopes, extra fields, wrong schema version, arbitrary IDs/paths and forbidden command names.
tests.then: Native facade rejects them; renderer cannot execute arbitrary Git/shell/filesystem operations.

tests.givenWhen: Inject test-only secret sentinels into provider errors, command diagnostics and exports.
tests.then: Sentinels do not occur in UI/DB/logs/events/export/argv/remote URLs; evidence is sanitized.

tests.givenWhen: Sync a fixture with binary LFS payloads, a missing object and a changed server endpoint.
tests.then: Real payload hashes checked; endpoint abuse rejected; partial coverage never labeled fully backed up.

tests.givenWhen: Restore LFS fixture using local/GitLab backup with GitHub access disabled.
tests.then: Materialized payloads match hashes; upload-only state is distinct from restore_verified.

tests.givenWhen: Use private/missing/cross-host submodule gitlinks and untrusted .gitmodules.
tests.then: No blind recursion or credential forwarding; coverage states child contents accurately.

tests.givenWhen: Test clean fast-forward, dirty index, untracked collisions, local commits, detached HEAD and divergence.
tests.then: Only safe clean fast-forward is applied; other workspaces remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

tests.givenWhen: Plan branch rewrite/tag move/delete with good, corrupt and disk-full snapshot storage.
tests.then: Destructive apply is blocked unless complete old-state recovery material is verified.

tests.givenWhen: Restore full Git bundle in a fresh directory with source network unavailable.
tests.then: All selected branches and annotated tags/OIDs match; no missing-object fetch from source.

tests.givenWhen: Inject 401/403/429/5xx, retry metadata, timeouts and a never-ending Git child.
tests.then: Bounded classified retry; auth prompts not retry storms; timeouts terminate/reap children.

tests.givenWhen: Cancel a child tree that fills stdout/stderr and spawns a helper.
tests.then: Pipes are drained boundedly, process tree stops and is reaped, terminal state is honest.

tests.givenWhen: Approve a plan then change a source ref, destination ref or policy revision.
tests.then: Approval invalidated or exact-OID lease rejects; no stale overwrite occurs.

tests.givenWhen: A previously backed-up repo disappears from API or returns 404 under a changed token.
tests.then: Existing local/GitLab copies and recovery snapshots are retained.

tests.givenWhen: Use shell-like refs, ext:: URLs, newline payloads, malicious global Git config, hooks and LFS endpoint redirection.
tests.then: No command injection, hook execution, root escape or cross-origin credential disclosure.

tests.givenWhen: Compare every required screen/state to an owner-approved design reference and accepted implementation golden.
tests.then: No self-approved golden; differences are reviewed at specified viewport and fixed fixture clock.

tests.givenWhen: Render every semantic registry entry and scan status/action DOM for Unicode substitutes.
tests.then: All exports compile to real SVGs; icon-only actions have accessible names; no status dots.

tests.givenWhen: Render long names, multiline errors, open dialogs and 200% text across supported sizes.
tests.then: No unintended sibling intersections, clipping, unreadable shrunk labels or offscreen actions.

tests.givenWhen: Complete onboarding, table selection, menus, tabs, dialog confirm/cancel and settings with keyboard.
tests.then: Logical focus, visible ring, focus trap/restore and accessible labels; no mouse-only action.

tests.givenWhen: Serialize native responses and validate against schema/FE validators and deterministic fixtures.
tests.then: Casing/nullability/status dimensions agree; summary totals match the same revision.

tests.givenWhen: Build production and inspect adapter wiring, fixture imports and feature controls.
tests.then: No test/demo fallback, fake timers-as-progress, placeholder success or unsupported working button.

tests.givenWhen: Build, install, start, reconnect, scan/sync sandbox and uninstall on clean supported Linux.
tests.then: Real runtime dependencies verified; user backups retained after uninstall; no browser-only claim.

tests.givenWhen: Close/minimize/quit, suspend/resume, lose tray host and restart during jobs.
tests.then: Reopen path safe; one coalesced scan on resume; no daemon or post-exit sync promise.

tests.givenWhen: Send helper requests with wrong peer/job/host/path and inspect child environment/argv.
tests.then: Only job-bound allowed requests receive credentials; no token env/argv/temp file; broker expires.

tests.givenWhen: Upgrade schema with sample data and interrupted migration; enforce active-job uniqueness.
tests.then: Foreign keys, revisions and recovery hold; no secret column values; no network inside transaction.

tests.givenWhen: Create times out after remote success; existing same-name unrelated destination also exists.
tests.then: Reconciliation finds only exact mapping; no duplicate or unintended adoption; visibility stays safe.

tests.givenWhen: Server rejects one ref/protected branch or lacks atomic support.
tests.then: No false atomic success; destructive multi-ref apply is blocked without atomic support; partial state reconciled.

tests.givenWhen: Git exits 0 but a ref differs afterward or source changes again during verification.
tests.then: Mismatch is failed/partial; newer source is update, not a perpetually synced claim.

tests.givenWhen: Drop/reorder duplicate progress and terminal invalidation events around subscribe/snapshot race.
tests.then: Committed native state wins; requery on gaps, unsubscribe on teardown, no stale overwrite.

tests.givenWhen: Observe and back up a repository with no commits/refs.
tests.then: Explicit empty manifest; no invalid bundle/push or fabricated HEAD; later first commit detected.

tests.givenWhen: A private source is mapped to a public destination and release debug/telemetry options are inspected.
tests.then: Visibility downgrade requires explicit consent or blocked; no hidden telemetry/debug access.

tests.givenWhen: Generate combinations of source, local, destination, workspace and LFS/job states.
tests.then: Precedence is deterministic; workspace dirty cannot overwrite correct mirror status or hide a blocker.

tests.givenWhen: Run supported screenshots/flows in actual Tauri WebKitGTK under Hyprland, not only Playwright Chromium.
tests.then: Native font, scale, titlebar, dialog, focus and scrolling verified on release candidate.
